path-parameter.name: id
path-parameter.description: 22-character base64url id of the persisted GeneratedHtmlPage.

operation.summary: Serves a previously generated HTML page by its id.
operation.description: Looks up the GeneratedHtmlPage with the given id and streams its htmlContent (Content-Type taken from the stored BinaryData, normally text/html). Returns 404 if no page with that id exists.
